name: @flirtual/pulumi-fly
description: Pulumi dynamic resources for Fly.io, driven through flyctl.

scripts.generate:config: schema=$(mktemp) && curl -sfL https://json.schemastore.org/fly.json -o "$schema" && json2ts -i "$schema" -o src/config.ts --bannerComment "// Generated from https://json.schemastore.org/fly.json by \`pnpm generate:config\`." && rm -f "$schema"
